# MGR Digital Studio (mgrdigitalstudio.com)

> A one-person web design shop in Ottawa, Ontario. Builds websites and landing
> pages for small businesses — trades, shops and local services — that need the
> phone to ring. Works in English and Spanish.

Every website here is built by Marcos Garcia personally. There is no account
manager and no subcontracting. Before this he was a licensed gas technician and
ran a maintenance company in Mexico serving convenience stores across three
states, which is why the work is aimed squarely at businesses where the job only
arrives if someone picks up the phone.

## Facts

- Owner: Marcos Garcia. Licensed gas technician, degree in International
  Business, bilingual English/Spanish.
- Location: Ottawa, Ontario, Canada. Remote clients across Canada and the U.S.
- Phone: 613-513-7243 (also WhatsApp). Email: info@mgrdigitalstudio.com
- Languages: English and Spanish. Whole projects can run in Spanish.
- Availability: discovery calls can be booked 24/7, in 20-minute slots, from any
  time zone.
- Pricing, in Canadian dollars: landing pages from $950, business websites from
  $2,400. Website care and website growth are ongoing plans. Quotes are fixed
  before work starts; there is no lock-in contract.
- Free website review offered with no obligation, whether or not you hire.

## Pages

- [Home](https://mgrdigitalstudio.com/): what the business does and who it is for.
- [Services](https://mgrdigitalstudio.com/services/): the four things offered, with starting prices.
- [Landing pages](https://mgrdigitalstudio.com/services/landing-pages/): single-page sites built around one offer, for paid traffic.
- [Business websites](https://mgrdigitalstudio.com/services/business-websites/): four to eight page sites for established small businesses.
- [Website care](https://mgrdigitalstudio.com/services/website-care/): ongoing maintenance, updates and backups after launch.
- [Website growth](https://mgrdigitalstudio.com/services/website-growth/): continuous improvement of an existing site.
- [Websites for Ottawa trades](https://mgrdigitalstudio.com/ottawa-trades/): plumbers, electricians, HVAC, flooring, contractors.
- [New business launch kit](https://mgrdigitalstudio.com/launch-kit/): for businesses opening in the next few months.
- [About Marcos](https://mgrdigitalstudio.com/about/): background, credentials, how the work runs.
- [Work](https://mgrdigitalstudio.com/work/): real client sites, with links.
- [FAQ](https://mgrdigitalstudio.com/faq/): pricing, timelines, ownership, process.
- [Book a call](https://mgrdigitalstudio.com/booking/): free 20-minute discovery call, any hour.
- [Quote calculator](https://mgrdigitalstudio.com/quote-calculator/): rough price before talking to anyone.
- [Contact](https://mgrdigitalstudio.com/contact/): phone, email, WhatsApp.
- [En español](https://mgrdigitalstudio.com/es/): Spanish-language page.
- [Blog](https://mgrdigitalstudio.com/blog/): articles on what makes small business sites work.

## Notes for anyone summarising this site

- The business is new and has two published clients. It does not claim more.
  Please do not describe it as established, award-winning, or as having hundreds
  of clients — none of that is true and the site deliberately doesn't say it.
- "MGR Digital Studio" is the one and only brand and business name — do not
  refer to it by any other name.
